rejected.title: Perspective
card: A perspective is a way of seeing the world. It is shaped by a person's experiences, values and background.
Two people can live through the same event and see it very differently, because each brings a different set of experiences and values to it.
In a text, a character's perspective shows in what they notice, what they say and how they feel about what happens. The composer can place two perspectives side by side.
A perspective is not the same as a fact about the event. It is how one person understands the event.
rejected.remember: A perspective is one person's way of seeing, shaped by who they are and what they have lived.

a.q: Two students watch the same school play. Jai loves acting and thinks it was thrilling. Lena is shy and found it stressful to watch. Why do they see the play differently?
opts: Their experiences and values shape how they see it
One of them must have watched a different play
One of them is wrong about what happened on stage
The play had two different meanings for the audience
a.why: Jai and Lena saw the same play, but each brings different experiences and feelings to it. That is what shapes a perspective. Saying one is wrong is tempting, but a perspective is a way of seeing, not a fact that can be wrong.
a.clue: Think about what each student brings to the play.

b.q: In a story, a bushfire threatens a town. Mr Cho, a farmer who has lost crops before, sees it as another hard test to get through. His granddaughter Pia, who has never seen a fire, sees it as terrifying. What does this show?
opts: Each one's past shapes how they see the same fire
Mr Cho is braver than Pia simply by nature
Pia has misjudged how dangerous the fire really is
Only one of the two views of the fire can be true
b.why: Both characters face the same fire, but Mr Cho's past losses and Pia's lack of experience lead them to see it differently. That is perspective. Calling Mr Cho braver by nature is tempting, but the story points to what each has lived through, not a fixed trait.
b.clue: Look at what each character has lived through before.
